recognize_zh: 低細胞量的腦脊髓液細胞離心抹片中，可見少數圓形細胞具偏心核、塊狀染色質與較豐富的灰藍細胞質，形態像漿細胞，配合骨髓瘤病史提示中樞神經侵犯；但倍率低，細節有限。
features: Paucicellular cytocentrifuge preparation with scattered red cells
Occasional medium-sized round cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse clock-face-like chromatin and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm, suggestive of plasma cells
Few small cells with dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm (lymphocytes)
Several degenerated/smudged cells with frayed cytoplasm
Low magnification limits assessment of perinuclear hof, nucleoli and cytoplasmic detail
describe_en: Cerebrospinal fluid cytospin is paucicellular and contains scattered red cells, a few small lymphocytes, degenerated cells, and occasional medium-sized round cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm resembling plasma cells. Given the low magnification, perinuclear hofs and nucleoli cannot be reliably assessed, and immunophenotypic confirmation (e.g., flow cytometry for CD138/CD38 with light chain restriction) is recommended. In a patient with plasma cell myeloma, the presence of plasma cells in CSF is suggestive of CNS involvement by myeloma.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasma cells in CSF (infection, demyelinating disease)
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are polytypic and accompanied by a mixed lymphocytic pleocytosis, whereas myeloma cells show light chain restriction.
Monocytes have folded or kidney-shaped nuclei with fine chromatin and vacuolated gray cytoplasm without an eccentric clock-face nucleus.
Lymphoma cells are usually larger with irregular nuclei and express B-cell markers (CD20, PAX5) rather than a pure CD138+ plasma cell phenotype.
